name: Jehu
overview: Jehu was a male member of the tribe of Simeon, identified specifically as the son of Joshibiah. His lineage is noted in 1 Chronicles 4:35, confirming his Simeonite heritage. Beyond his tribal affiliation and paternal connection, no further personal notes are recorded.
namesAndTitles: The name Jehu means 'y-h-v-h is he,' reflecting a theophoric element referencing the LORD. This proper name is documented in 1 Chronicles 4:35, though it is not indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jehu as the son of Joshibiah, as stated in 1 Chronicles 4:35. No additional family relationships are documented beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Jehu's significance lies in his identification as a Simeonite descendant through Joshibiah, situating him within the genealogical records of Israel. This connection contributes to the biblical account of the tribe of Simeon's lineage, underscoring the faithfulness of God in preserving His people through generations. While limited in narrative detail, Jehu's mention affirms the continuity of God's covenantal promises within Israel's tribal framework.
